messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "reliever inhaler is kept on hand"
set: ["reliever inhaler is kept on hand", "keep on hand at all times", "drinking kept modest", "use the dose counter on your albuterol inhaler device", "replace your inhaler if it is washed or placed in water", "caregiver should know where naloxone is kept and how to use it", "keeping your inhaler clean is important to ensure you are receiving the medication", "may be kept at room temperature", "follow all product instructions on how to clean your albuterol inhaler device and mouthpiece", "kept in original carton until time of administration", "on dialysis", "do not puncture or burn an empty inhaler canister", "is normal", "always use the new inhaler device provided with your refill", "may be kept at room temperature up to 86°F (30°C)", "child's dose is based on the age and weight of the child"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
